description:
Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

Rock and Mineral Collection
Educational Specimen Lot With Labeled Display Board
Approximately 68 Pieces, Natural and Tumbled Stones
A comprehensive geological collection featuring a wide array of rock and mineral specimens. The collection provides a broad survey of mineralogy, including various silicates, oxides, and carbonates.

Identification board remains sealed in original protective plastic wrap

Orders are shipped using

description: This lot includes a Dan & Darci 'Break & Discover Geodes' kit with unopened geodes in a drawstring bag, a large rough petrified wood specimen (7-8 inches tall), a polished stone, assorted mineral specimens in plastic bags including rough rose quartz, and a gemstone identification kit from Asheville's Nature Center with various small tumbled or rough stones plus an identification chart. Also included is a decorative stone globe on a brass stand. Items are in good used or new condition, suitable for collectors, education, or display.

description:
Authentic vintage Lalique "Pinsons" Crystal Bowl (model 11016), originally designed by Ren Lalique in 1933.
Features a molded relief pattern of small finches (pinsons) nestled among arched, serrated leaves and foliage.
Material: Crafted from clear and frosted (satin-finished) pressed crystal.
Handwritten "Lalique France" script mark.
Era: The elegant cursive script with no letter "R" means it was made after 1945. Pieces made during Ren Lalique’s lifetime usually feature a blocky, molded "R. LALIQUE" mark. After his death in 1945, his son Marc dropped the "R" and began using hand-engraved cursive scripts.Signature Authenticity: Authentic post-war Lalique signatures are typically tiny, thin, and lightly hand-etched or scribe-signed. They are carefully tucked away between the frosted leaves or on the outer bottom edge so they do not ruin the artwork.
Dimensions: Measures approximately 9.25 inches in diameter and 3.75 inches in height.

The items are from the same Goodwill location.

You have not already paid for any of the items.
